tips.rookiePlay102: How did you end up here?
tips.rookiePlay103: This is the Demon King's dungeon — every floor is guarded by many monsters.
tips.rookiePlay104: Now you can see the monsters and some usable potions; the exit is behind the door.
tips.rookiePlay105: But you can never know whether an exit leaves the dungeon or leads to the next floor.
tips.rookiePlay201: Let me tell you some basic rules.
tips.rookiePlay202: A number on the ground shows how many monsters hide in the 8 surrounding tiles.
tips.rookiePlay204: Follow me — tap the flashing tile.
tips.rookiePlay205: When you're not sure, use a throwing knife to scout.
tips.rookiePlay206: Pick up the knife and let's use it to scout.
tips.rookiePlay208: Looks like we've run into an enemy.
tips.rookiePlay209: Long-press to view a monster's details.
tips.rookiePlay210: Now long-press the tile the hand points to.
tips.rookiePlay211: Every monster has special stats and skills. Now let's try attacking it.
tips.rookiePlay213: When an Eye Demon dies, it opens the empty tiles around it.
tips.rookiePlay215: There's an apple — we can drag it away to read the number on the tile.
tips.rookiePlay217: There's a potion — let's tap it.
tips.rookiePlay218: It went into the item bar. Let's keep going.
tips.rookiePlay219: Let's try out the bomb potion.
tips.rookiePlay220: Now let's learn a new action: marking monsters manually.
tips.rookiePlay221: We mark a tile by hand to remind ourselves a monster is there.
tips.rookiePlay222: Follow the hand and long-press that tile.
tips.rookiePlay223: Great, you did it! Let's try once more.
tips.rookiePlay224: Excellent. The Demon King's minions fill the dungeon — explore carefully, hero.
tips.onSneakedGuide02: When monsters ambush, they use all kinds of skills to hurt you.
tips.onSneakedGuide03: You can use throwing knives and potions to scout ahead.
tips.onMonsterMarkedGuide02: You can also check a monster's stats to decide whether to kill it.
tips.onMonsterMarkedGuide03: Note: you don't have to kill every monster — grab the treasure and head to the next floor.
tips.rookiePlay501: Looks like you have a chance to break through the Demon King's blockade.
tips.rookiePlay502: Let me introduce a powerful ally — he'll fight alongside me to help you.
tips.rookiePlay503: I'm just a gardener, really, but my plant darlings are formidable.
tips.rookiePlay504: Getting to know them well will make your battles much easier.
tips.rookiePlay505: Now I'll give you my relic, and you'll be able to command my plants.
tips.openAvatarView02: Here you can see your stats, common skills, and some settings to choose from.
tips.openAvatarView03: Tap back to return to the battle.
tips.onUnlockOccupationGuide01: My friend, you've come at last — the Halloween Treant has kept me locked up here for so long.
tips.onUnlockOccupationGuide02: Thank you for saving me. You can pick me on the start screen to fight by your side.
tips.rookieKillBoss02: Nurse, gangster — come save me, quick!
tips.killHalloweenTreantFirstTime02: As thanks, I can help you in battle once.
